facility.name: The Goddard School of Haslet

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A contractor with the operation left a child unsupervised in a classroom for approximately 9 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not show good judgement when she pulled on a child's arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not show good judgement when moving an infant by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Parent's signature was missing for one child's health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Operation didn't notify licensing with in two day of incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 10 children's files are missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 3 of 10 children's files were missing name, address, and telephone number of the child s physician or an emergency-care facility.   4 of 10 children's files are missing emergency contacts or an address for the emergency contact.   1 of 10 children's files are missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. The caregiver grabbed the child by the arm, the child received a scratch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: One child is still lacking health provider statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the preponderance of evidence of the investigation, the caregivers have yelled at the children when they get frustrated with behaviors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the preponderance of evidence of the investigation, a caregiver has grabbed children by the arm to take them to time out. This has resulted in bruises left on at least one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One caregiver was lacking current CPR training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kits in the buses were lacking:    Bus #1: antiseptic and a thermometer   Bus #2: antiseptic, thermometer, and gloves  Bus #3: tweezers, antiseptic, and thermometer
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Six infants did not have current feeding instructions on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: In reviewing 10 children?s files:    One was lacking the complete home address for the child, the parents address, and the parents phone number.    Four were lacking either the emergency contact person or the complete information for that person.    Three were lacking transportation permission and water permission.    Four were lacking either the health care provider?s information or the complete information for the health care providers on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The operation did not provide three months of menus for review as requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: In reviewing 10 children's files, three were lacking health provider statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation has not completed the F2885 since 10/2020.      It was updated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: In reviewing 10 staff files:     Six were lacking signed documentation showing preservice was completed.  Five were lacking documentation showing orientation was completed.     Six staff were lacking the trainings in required topics.      Two were lacking documentation showing how they met educational requirements.    Two were lacking affidavits.    Five were lacking documentation showing they received the operation policies and personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies/parent handbook is lacking: #14, #15, #16, #18 (A-G), #26(B, C, & E).  The following sections need to be updated: #2.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: Four drivers were lacking transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: In reviewing 10 children's records, one was lacking immunizations on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver was lacking current First Aid training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that an incident report was not completed when a child was left in a classroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that the director not only failed to make a report regarding a situation that placed a child a risk, but also instructed the staff and owner not to report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that a child was left alone in a classroom unsupervised.  The caregiver did not have visual or auditory awareness of the children, or physical proximity to intervene if need.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that the owner knew of an incident that happened at the operation yet failed to report it to the parents or childcare regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that the parent of a child that was left in a classroom alone was not notified of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined that the operation failed to make a report to childcare regulation when a child was left in a classroom alone for an unknown amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation.  It was determined that neither caregiver intervened when a child left the classroom and went outside of the building.  This resulted in a child getting across the busy road in front of the center and was picked up by a passerby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation.  It was determined that two caregivers did not use good judgment when not going after a child when the child ran out of the room. This resulted in the child being able to exit the building and was found on the side of the road by a passerby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation.  It was determined that a child was not appropriately being supervised.  The child left the classroom and building.  The child was able to get across a busy road and picked up by a passerby due to the lack of supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: Three high school interns that volunteer at the operation do not have background checks on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))
